# Tucker's Casino

> Tucker's Casino is a laid-back neighborhood bar on Euclid Ave in East Cleveland with karaoke nights. Rated 4.1 from 315 Google reviews.

- Type: Bar
- Address: 15532 Euclid Ave, East Cleveland, OH 44112, USA

## About
Tucker's has been around for a very long time. Despite the name, we're not an actual casino. We're a straightforward neighborhood bar on Euclid Ave in East Cleveland, and folks rate us 4.1 from 315 Google reviews.
Our crowd leans a little older, and people here actually talk to each other. On the weekends more of the place opens up, and karaoke brings everybody together. Come as you are, and if you've got a sharp suit, wear it.

## Services
- Bar service: Simple, no-fuss drinks. One reviewer said the bar service is quick.
- Karaoke: Grab the mic on karaoke nights on the weekends.

## FAQ
Q: Is Tucker's an actual casino?
A: No. Despite the name, we're a neighborhood bar, not a casino.

Q: Do you take cards?
A: One reviewer noted the bar is cash only, so it's a good idea to bring cash. Call us if you want to check before you come.

Q: When is karaoke?
A: Karaoke happens on the weekends, including Sunday karaoke night.

## What customers say
- "The atmosphere was fantastic. I would not consider this a bar at all it more like a lounge. It was fun people were actually talking to each other rather than being on their cellphones. The karaoke performers gave it their all I love every thing about it! I will be going back." (Kwanetta Finney, 5/5)
- "tucker’s haves been around for a very long time. its a great place for people who loves to wear graham crackers colored steve harvey suits. weekends are great because they have karaoke and they do not sell food. the bar is cash only but it is a great place to be!" (MarLesia Wren, 5/5)
- "The place is old, needs updating, and caters to an older crowd (40 and older). Food is brought in on request by a local caterer. Bar service is quick. Vibe is great, especially on Sunday karoake night." (Eugenia Green, 5/5)
- "Did not stay, just wanted to say happy birthday 🎂" (Ms.Tara N Corethers, 5/5)
- "It is a bar that has 3 different sides that has something going on different in each one. Only on the weekends. It' is not a actual casino. During the week just one side is open, it's small. I like it because it's an older crowd.  They do not sell food at all." (Lakia, 4/5)
